Overview

About PMFME

PMFME supports the upgradation and formalisation of micro food processing enterprises. Individual units receive a credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of the eligible project cost, up to ₹10 Lakh.

The scheme follows a One District One Product (ODOP) approach. FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives can also receive support for common infrastructure, branding and marketing.

Key benefits

  • 35% capital subsidy on eligible project cost
  • Seed capital support for SHG members
  • Support for common processing infrastructure
  • Help with branding, marketing and FSSAI compliance
  • Training and handholding support

Who is eligible

  • Existing or new micro food processing unit
  • Applicant aged 18 or above with ownership of the enterprise
  • Proprietorship or partnership firm; FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives also eligible
  • Preference for ODOP products of the district
  • Beneficiary contribution of at least 10% of project cost

Documents required

  • Aadhaar and PAN
  • Detailed project report
  • Bank statements for the last 6 months
  • Udyam, GST and FSSAI registration (if available)
  • Rent agreement or ownership proof of premises
  • Machinery quotations
